items.raw_excerpt: A man has been fined after being pulled over by police while lying next to a fridge sticking out the back of a car.
items.summary_en: Queensland police pulled over a car with a fridge hanging out of the boot. The driver was lying down next to the fridge inside the car. Officers said they could see his feet. He was fined.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즐랜드 경찰은 트렁크에서 냉장고가 삐져나와 있던 차를 세웠습니다. 운전자는 차 안에서 냉장고 옆에 누워 있었습니다. 경찰은 발이 보인다고 해 그를 단속했고, 운전자는 벌금을 받았습니다.
items.title_en: 'We can see your feet': Man fined for lying next to fridge in car boot

items.raw_excerpt: The Fiji Rugby Union (FRU) is actively seeking development compensation from overseas clubs when local talent transfers internationally, in accordance with World Rugby regulations.
items.summary_en: Fiji Rugby Union is asking overseas clubs for money when Fiji players move to them. The club must help develop young Fijian rugby talent. The fees follow World Rugby rules.
items.summary_ko: 피지 럭비 연합은 피지 선수가 해외 클럽으로 옮길 때 돈을 요구하고 있다. 그 클럽은 젊은 피지 럭비 인재를 양성해야 한다. 이|isbn은 월드 럭비 규정에 따른 것이다.
items.title_en: Fiji Rugby Wants Overseas Clubs to Pay Development Fees

items.raw_excerpt: A ranked look at Mexico's five largest freshwater lakes by surface area, from Lake Chapala to Laguna Catemaco.
items.summary_en: Mexico has five large freshwater lakes. Lake Chapala is the biggest one in the country. Laguna Catemaco is also on the list, and it sits high in the mountains.

items.title_en: Mexico's Five Biggest Lakes by Size

items.summary_en: Two tourism investments are planned for the Greek islands of Rhodes and Meganisi. Investors are putting money into hotels and tourism. The projects will add many new rooms for visitors.

items.raw_excerpt: Discover Cadgwith, the small fishing village on the Lizard Peninsula, Cornwall, used to film HBO's new Harry Potter TV series.
items.summary_en: Cadgwith is a small fishing village on the Lizard Peninsula in Cornwall, England. Local people say the place has not changed and that time has passed it by. The village was used as a filming location for the new Harry Potter TV series on HBO.
items.summary_ko: 영국 코너설의 리자드 반도에는 카드위스라는 작은 어촌 마을이 있습니다. 마을 사람들은 이곳은 변하지 않았고 시간도 지나쳐 간 듯하다고 말합니다. 이 마을은 HBO의 새 해리 포터 TV 드라마 촬영지로 사용되었습니다.
items.title_en: Small Cornwall fishing village used to film new Harry Potter TV show

items.raw_excerpt: The Ministry of Education is investigating concerns raised at Horowhenua College in the lower North Island.
items.summary_en: New Zealand's Ministry of Education is looking into serious concerns about the leaders at Horowhenua College. The school is in the lower North Island. The ministry has not yet said what the concerns are or what it will do next.

items.title_en: Education Ministry Checks School Leaders at Horowhenua College

items.raw_excerpt: Nine years ago, a little girl in Phuket overslept. That single, ordinary mistake would eventually lead her to the global stage -- and to becoming one of Thailand's most talked-about young musicians.
items.summary_en: Nine years ago, a little girl in Phuket woke up late and got in trouble at school. That one small mistake set her on a new path. Now she is one of Thailand's most talked-about young musicians.
items.summary_ko: 9년 전 푸켓의 소녀가 늦잠을 자고 학교에서 혼났습니다. 그 작은 실수가 그녀의 길을 완전히 바꿨습니다. 지금 그녀는 태국에서 가장 화제되는 젊은 음악인 중 한 명입니다.

items.raw_excerpt: This city stands out as the world's most helpful destination, with hundreds of services designed to assist visitors.
items.summary_en: A survey picked an Asian city as the most helpful place in the world for visitors. Hundreds of local services there are made to help tourists. Visitors can ask for help and get easy support in many languages.

items.raw_excerpt: Tasmanian Minister Felix Ellis says Liberal MPs will have a conscience vote on the Greens' bill to ban conversion practices in the state — and he'll be "voting no".
items.summary_en: In Tasmania, Australia, the Liberal Party will let its members vote freely on a Greens bill to ban conversion practices. State Minister Felix Ellis says he will vote against the bill.

items.title_en: Tasmania Plans Free Conscience Vote on Conversion Ban

items.raw_excerpt: The original Wallace & Gromit, Shaun the Sheep and Feathers McGraw puppets have been auctioned to help fund "opportunities for emerging filmmakers".
items.summary_en: The original Wallace and Gromit, Shaun the Sheep and Feathers McGraw puppets from Aardman were sold at an auction. The money will go to fund opportunities for emerging filmmakers.

items.raw_excerpt: Lawmakers this week published a bill that would require Liga MX to restore a path for second-division clubs to reach the top flight.
items.summary_en: Senators in Mexico published a bill that would force Liga MX to create a path for second-division clubs to move up to the top flight. The bill would bring back the old promotion and relegation system. The soccer league has kept the second tier closed for years, so few small clubs can grow.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코 상원은 리가 멕시에 2부 리그에서 1부로 올라오는 길을 다시 만들도록 하는 법안을 공개했다. 이 법안은 예전에 쓰이던 승강제 체계를 되살리는 내용이다. 리가 멕시는 오랫동안 2부 리그를 닫아 두어 소규모 구단이 성장하기 어려운 상황이다.
items.title_en: Mexico Senate bill would bring back soccer promotion and relegation
items.title_original: Senate bill would force Mexican pro soccer to bring back promotion and relegation

items.raw_excerpt: A West Auckland man has discovered the Lotto ticket he had been using as a bookmark for almost two months is worth $20.1 million.
items.summary_en: An Auckland man found out that a Lotto ticket he had used as a bookmark for almost two months was worth $20.1 million. He had been looking for the missing ticket since the draw in August. He said he had almost stopped hoping that it was a real win.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드의 한 남자가 2개월 동안 책갈피로 쓰고 서랍에 방치했던 로또 복권이 2,010만 달러에 당첨된 사실을 알게 됐다. 그는 8월 당첨 발표 뒤 한동안 복권을 찾지 못해 정말 당첨됐다는 사실을 믿지 못했다고 말했다.
items.title_en: Auckland man used missing $20.1 million Lotto ticket as a bookmark for two months
items.title_ko: 책갈피로 2개월 쓰던 로또 복권, 2,010만 달러 당첨
